detections.explain: A very large resting order (≥ 8× the typical level and ≥ 10% of that side's visible depth within 5%) appeared and was cancelled within a minute without being traded and without price reaching it. Classic spoofing looks like this: a fake wall that scares the other side, pulled before it can fill. Market makers also do it legitimately, so treat it as a hint.

Within one minute, far more size was placed and cancelled near the price (±2%) than actually traded (cancel-to-trade ratio ≥ 30 and ≥ 3σ above this book's norm): order-book noise that can mislead depth readers.

evaluation.note: abs = median |mid move| after the event vs control samples (random 5-min samples on the same books); signed = move in the direction the signal implies (pulled bid wall -> down, pulled ask wall -> up), hit = share positive. Small n early on: wait for hundreds of events before trusting.

explain.spoof_wall: A very large resting order (≥ 8× the typical level and ≥ 10% of that side's visible depth within 5%) appeared and was cancelled within a minute without being traded and without price reaching it. Classic spoofing looks like this: a fake wall that scares the other side, pulled before it can fill. Market makers also do it legitimately, so treat it as a hint.
explain.wall_pulled: A large wall that rested for more than a minute was cancelled (not filled) before price reached it.
explain.pulled_before_move: A wall at least 0.5% away was pulled and, within a minute, price moved at least halfway toward where it stood: the wall was holding price back (or advertising a level), then got out of the way.
explain.churn: Within one minute, far more size was placed and cancelled near the price (±2%) than actually traded (cancel-to-trade ratio ≥ 30 and ≥ 3σ above this book's norm): order-book noise that can mislead depth readers.
explain.thin_book: Visible depth within ±1% of the price fell to less than half of its 30-minute median (≥ 3σ drop): the book is thin, so a modest order can move price a lot. Liquidity often disappears just before sharp moves.

venuesNotUsed.gate: public spot.order_book works (verified) but not wired to keep the collector bounded
venuesNotUsed.dex: Raydium/Orca CLMM tick liquidity needs on-chain RPC tick-array reads (not wired); DEX depth is not covered
